However, the developers i.e. the Respondents herein approached this Tribunal contending that a project-specific review of tariff must be done, as contemplated by the order dated 20.06.2001 passed by the State Commission. By way of its order dated 20.01.2016, it was held by the Tribunal that a review of tariff must be done individually for each project based on the order of the State Commission dated 20.06.2001, which provided for such review of tariff on an individual basis after 10 years of completion. This order of the State Commission has attained finality and the same has also been affirmed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
